notablePrerequisites: Astral Cornucopia has at least six charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vineweft, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Activate Vineweft by paying {4}{G}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
